WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to make available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS, Owner desires to retain the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term“zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot of the Owner Parcel, the Air Rights Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Merged Zoning Lot"), and (ii) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with the Excess Development Rights (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); WHEREAS,Owner desires toutilize theRetainedDevelopment Rights(as hereinafter defined) for the construction of an Additional Floor (as hereinafter defined), which, when constructed, shall be deemed part of the Owner Building; Owner Representations. Owner represents and warrants to, and covenants with, Developer that (a) it is seized of the Owner Parcel in fee simple, it has the right to enter into the Declaration, this Agreement and the Zoning Documents and is the only party in interest withrespecttotheOwnerParcelthathasnotwaivedand/orsubordinateditsrighttoexecutethe Declaration, this Agreement and the Zoning Documents, (b) it has not previously sold, leased, transferred, or encumbered the Excess Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner Parcel in any manner whatsoever, (c) it will execute or procure any further assurances reasonably required by Developer of its right to enter into the Declaration, this Agreement and the Zoning Documents, (d) it will forever warrant and defend the right to utilize the Excess Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner Parcel for the benefit of Developer, its successors and assigns, subject to applicable zoning and other laws, rules and regulations, (e) the execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement by it does not violate the provisions of any mortgage or any other agreement or instrument to which it is a party or by which it is bound, (f) any consideration is not a “foreign person” as defined in section 1445(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code and the regulationsissuedthereunder. 5. Floor Area Notice.Notice is hereby given that this Agreement restricts the Owner Parcel, and benefits the Developer Parcel, by (i) reducing (subject to the terms of this Agreement) the Development Rights which are appurtenant to the Owner Parcel by 5,810 square feet of floor area, all of which comprises the Excess Development Rights utilizable by Developer pursuant to this Agreement as of the date hereof, and (i) allowing the Developer Parcel the exclusive right to and benefit of the Excess Development Rights. 9 KL3:2241847.5

6. Separate Building Plans.The parties hereto agree that all construction plans and specifications for, and applications for a certificate of occupancy or any building, alteration, demolition or otherpermits for anybuilding on the OwnerParcel shall be separate and independent from those for any building on the Developer Parcel and vice versa and shall be filed with the Department of Buildings so as to obtain separate “"new building" and “alteration" numbers, as appropriate, so long as permitted by applicable law. 7. Separate Tax Lots.The parties acknowledge that the separate interests of each of them require that the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel and any other parcels now or hereafter merged into the Merged Zoning Lot be treated for real property tax purposes as separate and independent tax lots. Owner and Developer shall take such actions, with respect to the Owner Parcel and Developer Parcel, respectively, as may be reasonably required to maintain the Parcels which comprise the Merged Zoning Lot as separate and independent tax lots. Neither tax lots, and neither party shall be precluded from contesting tax assessments on its own Parcel. Developer and Owner each agrees to cooperate with the other in connection with any application, filings or proceedings relating to the assessed valuation of the Owner Parcel and/or the Developer Parcel which may be filed or instituted by the owner of such Parcel in furtherance oftheforegoingprovisions ofthisSection7. 8. Violation Cure Rights. (a) In the event that at any time hereafter there exists any Violation on the OwnerParcel which adversely affects the rights of Developer with respect toDeveloper Parcel, Owner shall commence a cure within fifteen (15) days after receiving notice of the same from Developer,and shall proceed diligently and continuously to cure,remove and discharge of record the same as rapidly as possible (or, if the cure, removal and discharge cannot with due diligence be completed in such fifteen (15) day period, Owner shall commence the cure, removal and discharge within such fifteen (15) day period and diligently prosecute to completion, the cure, removal and discharge of any Violation). In the event that Owner does not commence such cure and proceed diligently and continuously with such cure as required by the immediately preceding sentence, Developer shall have the right to cure suchViolation at the expense and for the account of Owner (and if necessary, in the name of Owner), and Owner will execute and deliver such documents as may be required in connection therewith, it being agreed that Developer shall have a license to have access to the Owner Parcel for the purpose of effecting such cure; provided, however, Developer covenants and agrees that such access and cure (i) shall only occur after notice to Owner,(i) except in the event of an emergency as reasonably determined by Developer, shall only occur at reasonable times, and (i) shall not unreasonably interfere with Owner's use and occupancy of the Owner Building; and provided, further, that during the period of such access and cure, Developer shall procure and maintain liability insurance, naming Owner (and any mortgagee of the Owner Parcel of which Developer has notice) as an additional insured, in the form and in the amounts customarily carried in connection with work of the type necessary to cure the Violation. In addition, Developer may, at its option, maintain any action permitted at law 10 KL3:2241847.5

action for injunctive relief to compel Owner to cure such Violation and/or a suit for damages arising from the failure by Owner to cure such Violation. (b)If Developer is compelled or elects to expend any sum of money or do any acts which require the payment of money by reason of complying with, remedying or curing a Violation on the Owner Parcel, as provided in this Section 8, Owner shall, upon demand, promptly reimburse Developer all such sums together with interest thereon at the lesser of (i) 18% per annum or (ii) maximum rate permitted by law, compounded annually, from the date of such expenditure. Developer shall have a lien on Owner's property in the amount of all such sums and interest not reimbursed by Owner in accordance with this Section 8(b). 9. Subdivision.Developer shall have the right to subdivide the Developer Parcel or the Merged Zoning Lot to the extent permitted by the Zoning Resolution and other applicable law, provided that such subdivision shall be subject to this Agreement and shall not adversely diminish Owner's right to utilize the Utilized Development Rights, the Retained Development Rightsor the Owner Parcel,asutilizedonthedatehereof,andaslimitedby the Declaration and this Agreement.Owner shall not have the right to subdivide the Owner Parcel or the Merged Zoning Lot.Developer shall not apply for any such subdivision without first furnishing Owner with: (i) a copy of the application, and (ii) the opinion of an architect licensed in New York State, familiar with New York City zoning requirements, addressed to Owner, stating the zoning consequences of the subdivision and concluding that the subdivision will not diminish Owner's right to utilize the Utilized Development Rights, the Retained Development RightsortheOwnerParcel,asutilizedonthedatehereof,andaslimitedbytheDeclarationand this Agreement. Owner shall cooperate with Developer in connection with any such subdivision, provided Developer shall pay any reasonable out-of-pocket fees and expenses incurred by Owner (including, but not limited to, attorneys’ and other professionals’ fees and expenses) in connection therewith. 10. Merged Zoning Lot, including Owner, are hereby deemed to have consented to and waived objection to enlarging the Merged Zoning Lot covered by the Declaration to include one or more additional parcels to be brought into the Merged Zoning Lot, and to have consented, subordinated and waived objection to each addition, modification, amendment, replacement, restatement or consolidation (each individually, an “Amendment,” and collectively "Amendments") to the Declaration and/or this Agreement, whether or not such parties sign such addition, modification, amendment, replacement, restatement or consolidation to the Declaration and/or this Agreement, subject to all the other terms and conditions of this Agreement, provided that such Amendment does not, by its terms, materially and adversely affect Owner's right to utilize the Utilized Development Rights, the Retained Development Rights or the Owner Parcel, as utilized on the date hereof, and as limited by the Declaration and this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, if requested by Developer, Owner shall, within fifteen (15) days after such request, execute, acknowledge and deliver one or more Amendments to the Declaration and/or this Agreement, or execute a waiver of Declaration or subordination to this 11 KL3:2241847.5

Agreement, and shall execute, acknowledge and deliver, or cause the execution, acknowledgement and delivery of, such other instruments as may reasonably be required, for the purposes of such enlargement of the Merged Zoning Lot. In the event that Owner shall not have executed and delivered,or caused tohave executed and delivered,within fifteen(15) days after demand therefor,any of the documents or instrumentshereinreferred to,thenDeveloper shall have the right to execute any such documents or instruments for, on behalf of, and as attorney-in- fact for Owner. In furtherance of the foregoing, Owner hereby irrevocably appoints Developer as its true and lawful attorney-in-fact, coupled with an interest, to execute any and all such documents or instruments. Developer shall furnish Owner with such documents as Owner may reasonably require in order to be assured that the enlarging of the Merged Zoning Lot is consistent with the terms of this Agreement. Developer shall pay any reasonable out-of-pocket fees and expenses incurred by Owner (including, but not limited to, attorneys’ and other professionals’ fees and expenses) in connection with the review, execution, acknowledgement and delivery of the documents pertaining to enlarging the Merged Zoning Lot pursuant to this Section 10. 11. TemporaryEasementsforSupports,ProtectiveCoveringand Construction. (a)( Owner grants to Developer easements in the Owner Parcel to use such portions of the Owner Parcel and the Owner Building as are required for the demolition of the Existing Developer Building and the construction, alteration or rebuilding of the Developer Building (collectively, “Construction"). Construction may include, to the extentrequiredbygoodconstructionpractice,(i)theconstructionandmaintenanceof a construction fence, (i) the attachment of foundation and building supports and shoring and bracing and underpinning of the Owner Building, (i) the attachment of sheds, bridges or other protective covering over the roof, facade and other portions of the Owner Building if required to safeguard the Owner Building from debris during Construction, (iv) the maintenance, repair and replacement of such attachments, provided that the manner of attachments shall be in accordance with good construction practice and in a load on the Owner Building (but nothing contained in this Agreement shall be construed construction equipment) on the roof or the rear yards of the Owner Parcel), and (v) the right to construct and maintain temporary scaffolding on the Owner Building or the Owner Parcel during Construction, provided that such scaffolding shall be constructed and maintained in compliance with good construction practice, shall provide for adequate security with respect to the Owner Parcel, and shall not unreasonably interfere with ingress and egress to the Owner Building. Developer shall give Owner five (5) days written notice prior to the commencement of the construction of any such scaffolding. (b)All of the easement rights set forth in this Agreement shall be exercised (i) in a prompt, safe and efficient manner and so as not to unreasonably interfere with the use, occupancy or structural integrity of the Owner Parcel or the buildings and improvements thereon (consistent, however, with good construction practice); (ii) taking 12 KL3.2241847.5

such precautions as may be necessary or appropriate to prevent damage to the Owner Parcel or injury to persons; and (i) so that on completion of any work, the area of any such work is restored to its former condition (insofar as possible) with all debris removed. (c)   During Construction, Developer shall, at its sole cost and expense, obtain and at all times maintain or cause to be obtained and maintained public liability insurance coverage to include personal injury, bodily injury, broad form property damage, operations hazard, independent contractor's coverage, contractual liability and products and completed operations liability, naming Owner as an additional insured, in amounts customarily maintained by a prudent contractor/developer/owner performing such work. (d) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, Owner consents to, and grants to Developer an easement for, temporary projections and/or intrusions extending from the Developer Parcel into the air space over the improved or unimproved portions of the Owner Parcel which are reasonably required in connection with the construction of the Developer Building, provided that such projections and/or intrusions (i) are not in violation of applicable law, (i) do not unreasonably interfere with Owner's use and occupancy of the Owner Building, (ii) are removed promptly after completion of the Developer Building, and (iv) are made in accordance with the terms and requirements of this Agreement (including the requirements of thisSection11).] 12.No Third Party Beneficiaries. No covenant or agreement contained herein shall inure to the benefit of any party, including, without limitation, any occupant of either the Developer Parcel or the Owner Parcel, other than to Owner and Developer, their respective heirs, distributees, successors and assigns, and any mortgagee of either the Developer Parcel or the Owner Parcel which may become a “mortgagee-in-possession,” except as otherwise specifically provided herein.
